name: Sheila
source:
A spirited woman who respects only strength and believes that the weak should be dominated. She continually makes fun of her brother, who cannot get stronger no matter how much he trains.

When Ober makes crazy demands of her, she tries her best not to give him the initiative, yet quickly rises to his mockery and ultimately does whatever he wants. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1250&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
